title: BC Friday Tips #30 DataAccessIntent
summary: The DataAccessIntent property can be set to ReadOnly on API pages and reports to direct the server to use a replica database, reducing load on the primary database and improving overall performance.
key_points: DataAccessIntent property signals the server to use a replica database when available
Set to ReadOnly for pages and reports that only perform read-only operations
Reduces load on the primary database for better performance
A single property setting can improve system efficiency

quotes.text: Set DataAccessIntent to ReadOnly when you only perform read-only data for API pages or reports.
quotes.why_it_matters: This is the core usage guidance for when to apply the property.

quotes.text: It signals the server to use a replica database when available.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the mechanism of how the property improves performance.

quotes.text: Using the replica lessens the load on the primary database, ensuring smoother operation for others.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the benefit of using replica databases for read-only operations.
